title: Profile-wide V2 official authority for the LangGraph competition profile
decision: Add a strict, startup-frozen competition-langgraph-v2 profile whose valid LangGraph evaluations use a deterministic V2 official decision with the current decision as the allow < ask < deny safety floor. Keep Guard API globally off by default and the existing reference profile explicitly shadow. Scope this authority to the competition activation manifest and label its Dashboard output as Competition profile official. Do not change or satisfy formal C11, I02B, I04, ROL1, R05, Gate B, S4, S5-O or cross-runtime completion. Split the work into independently claimed LGV2-C, LGV2-I, LGV2-B and LGV2-FE nodes. The active R05 allocation remains limited to its residual OpenClaw host-capability surface.
rationale: The competition needs a real LangGraph product loop instead of a demonstration-only shadow loop, while the formal four-path and cross-runtime activation gates remain intentionally unfinished. A frozen profile manifest, deterministic official evidence, explicit current safety floor and isolated read-only presentation make the limited authority auditable without misrepresenting formal rollout readiness. The dedicated bench surface lets runner and artifact-contract work proceed in parallel with Core without overlapping Guard API or adapter authority wiring.
